forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.description: Enter your account email and we will send you a link to reset your password.

activate.title: Activate your account
activate.greeting: Hello <bold>{{name}}</bold>, set a password to get started.
activate.invalidHint: Ask your administrator to send the link again, or use Forgot password to get a new activation link.

criteria.label: Password requirements
criteria.CONTAINS_EMAIL: Does not contain your email name
criteria.CONTAINS_EMAIL_LATER: Does not contain your email name (checked when saving)
criteria.WHITESPACE: Does not start or end with a space

invalidCredentials.title: Incorrect User ID or password.
invalidCredentials.description: Check them again, or use Forgot password to reset it.

activated.title: Your account is active.
activated.description: Log in with the password you just set.

reset.description: Log in with your new password.

menu.label: Account

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.description: Log out the devices you do not recognize.
sessions.onlyThisDevice: No other device is signed in.
sessions.loadFailedDescription: Check your connection and try again.

createUser.title: Create account
createUser.description: The user will get an email to set their own password.
createUser.adminWarning: Administrators have full control over the system.
